items.fullText: 코리아마켓 한경 PREMIUM9 AI를 넘어서는 성공투자 구독하기 AI 추천 뉴스 AI 추천 뉴스 팝업 닫기 "삼성SDI, ESS 사업 호조로 실적 개선 국면 본격화…목표가↑"-대신 입력 2026.10.30 07:38 수정 2026.10.30 07:38 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 한경우 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. 삼성SDI 본사 기흥사업장 / 사진=삼성SDI 대신증권은 30일 삼성SDI 에 대해 북미 시장을 중심으로 에너지저장장치(ESS) 수주와 출하가 급증하는 등 실적 개선 국면에 접어들었다며 목표주가를 기존 74만원에서 75만원으로 올렸다. 투자의견은 ‘매수’를 유지했다. 당장 3분기 실적부터 예상을 크게 웃돌았다. 삼성SDI의 2026년 3분기 연결 기준 매출액은 전년 동기 대비 53.5% 증가한 4조6856억원, 영업이익은 4078억원으로 흑자전환했다. 영업이익은 시장 컨센서스(1913억 원)를 두 배 이상 웃돌았다. 지배주주 순이익 역시 전년 동기 대비 515.4% 급증한 2946억 원을 기록했다. 이번 호실적은 일회성 요인을 제외하더라도 기초 체력이 크게 개선된 결과라고 김귀연 대신증권 연구원은 분석했다. 고객사 물량 보상금과 품질 비용을 합산한 약 2000억원의 일회성 이익이 반영됐으나, 이를 제외한 실질 영업이익 역시 2000억원에 달했기 때문이다. 전지 사업 부문 매출이 전년 동기 대비 56.4% 늘어난 4조4099억 원, 영업이익 3619억 원을 거두며 흑자 전환을 이끌었다고 김 연구원은 강조했다. 특히 ESS 사업이 주목된다. 삼성SDI는 올해 10월까지 미국 전력용 시장을 중심으로 각형 폼팩터 경쟁력을 앞세워 누적 60GWh 이상의 ESS 수주를 확보했다. 이에 따라 미국과 울산 생산 라인은 2028년 물량까지 가동 능력이 모두 채워진 상태다. 4분기부터는 미국 현지 라인에서 ESS용 리튬인산철(LFP) 배터리 양산과 출하가 본격화되면서 인플레이션 감축법(AMPC) 보조금 수혜와 함께 외형 성장이 이어질 것이라고 대신증권은 전망했다. 김 연구원은 “4분기는 일회성 기저 효과로 전 분기 대비 손익 축소가 불가피하다”면서도 “북미 ESS 신규 증설과 수주 가속, 4분기 ESS 출하에 따른 실적 턴어라운드 본격화, 2027년 유럽 완성차 업체의 전기차 물량 수혜 가능성을 고려하면 주가 우위가 지속될 것”이라고 말했다. 한경우 한경닷컴 기자 case@hankyung.com 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 ⓒ 한경닷컴, 무단전재 및 재배포 금지 한국경제 구독신청 한경 프리미엄9 구독신청 한경우 기자 한경우 기자는 한경닷컴에서 주식투자에 대한 기사를 쓰고 있습니다. 개별 종목 분석과 퀀트 투자 콘텐츠에 특히 두각을 나타냅니다. 그는 2014년 농식품 전문 매체에서 기자 생활을 시작했고, 이후 경제매체 산업부로 자리를 옮겨 중화학공업과 해운, 제약·바이오 산업을 출입하며 주요 산업에 대한 이해를 쌓았습니다. 이를 바탕으로 심층적인 종목 분석 기사를 작성하고 있습니다. ‘한경우의 케이스스터디’ 코너에는 주로 퀀트 투자 콘텐츠가 연재되고 있습니다. 에프앤가이드와 코스콤의 데이터 플랫폼을 능숙하게 다루기에 특정 투자지표를 조건 삼아 관심을 가져 볼만한 종목을 선별해 독자들에게 제시합니다. ‘투자톡’ 코너를 통해서는 각 투자 전략을 장기간 시뮬레이션한 백테스트 콘텐츠를 선보이고 있습니다. items.t: GM reaches $220M settlement over selling drivers’ private data
items.d: As part of the settlement, GM must get drivers’ express consent before it collects or shares their driving and location data.
items.fullText: General Motors will pay $220 million to 36 states to settle allegations that it illegally sold private driving behavior and location information to data brokers. As part of the settlement, GM must get drivers’ express consent before it collects or shares their driving and location data — terms that are in line with separate agreements it previously reached with California and the Federal Trade Commission (FTC). This settlement does contain a new requirement that GM must have a third party assess the automaker’s compliance with the privacy program it has put in place. The agreement announced Thursday settles a lawsuit brought by a coalition of attorneys general from 36 states that alleged GM had sold the information to data brokers, which in turn then sold it to insurance providers. “This agreement addresses Smart Driver, a product we ended in 2024, and reinforces steps we’ve taken to strengthen our privacy practices,” GM said in an emailed statement. “Safer, more helpful and personalized experiences are enabled by connected vehicle data, and GM is committed to being clear about what information is used, how it’s protected, and the choices customers have about what they share.” The settlement comes more than two years after a New York Times report showed how GM and OnStar collected, used, and sold drivers’ precise geolocation data and driving behavior to third parties, including data brokers LexisNexis and Verisk. The data was collected through GM’s Smart Driver program, a free feature contained within its connected car apps that tracked and rated driving behaviors and seat belt use. Data brokers sold this information to insurance providers, which could affect customers’ rates, the NYT reported at the time. GM discontinued Smart Driver in 2024, but that didn’t stop legal action. items.t: As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience
items.d: As AI transforms how people find information online, Reddit is rethinking its open-web roots to protect its audience and business.
items.fullText: Reddit has long attracted millions of users to its site through Google, with many even appending the word “Reddit” to their search queries for better answers. But as search traffic dries up amid the shift to AI-powered search, Reddit is rethinking its relationship with the open internet. In its third-quarter earnings call on Thursday, the company announced it’s transitioning to a primarily “logged-in experience.” The move is designed to protect its data from AI scraping, allowing the company to instead forge lucrative licensing deals with model providers. But just as important, such a shift could help Reddit to increase its revenue even as it faces daily active user declines in its largest market, the U.S. Overall, Reddit’s global daily active users were flat quarter-over-quarter in Q3, reaching 130.3 million, while U.S. daily active users dropped from 53.2 million in Q2 to 50.7 million in Q3 and were down 2% year-over-year. Image Credits: Reddit The company is not alone in seeing such declines; the shift to an AI-centered web has impacted most websites and publishers by now, leading to fewer click-throughs, as AI summaries provide answers that don’t require website visits and Google’s traditional “ten blue links” have reduced relevance. (The change is now even impacting Google’s bottom line , its earnings revealed.) But at Reddit’s scale, the numbers associated with such a decline are enormous. The company said search traffic referrals dropped by more than 1 million referrals on average per week in October. It warned that if the trend continues, daily active users could decline to a low-double-digit percentage by next quarter. (To play that out: a hypothetical 10% to 12% decline could bring Reddit to roughly 115 million to 117 million daily actives, down from 130.3 million in Q3. That’s a huge drop!) items.t: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings acquires ADT
items.d: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings is buying ADT in a $15.3 billion deal, with plans to bring AI to the home security business.
items.fullText: In Brief Posted: 12:56 PM PDT · October 29, 2026 Image Credits: Timon Schneider/SOPA Images/LightRocket / Getty Images Julie Bort OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings acquires ADT Thrive Holdings has acquired physical security company ADT for $10 per share or about $7.6 billion in equity, the companies announced on Thursday. Beyond equity, the total enterprise value of the deal is $15.3 billion, ADT said. Thrive Holdings is the PE spinout from Josh Kushner’s powerhouse VC firm Thrive Capital. It also counts OpenAI as its partner , as well as an investor. The firm’s mission is to hold other companies long-term, revitalizing them with AI. Currently, Thrive Holdings holds over 75 companies, it says. As a partner, OpenAI supplies AI models and tech as well as people, otherwise known as forward-deployed engineers, to Thrive’s companies. Neither ADT nor Thrive announced what new AI-powered security products they will be releasing, but they did tease that the plan was to invest and release new products. “ADT will form the foundation of Thrive Holdings’ smart home security business,” the press release said. AI-powered physical security is having a moment right now. Apple just entered the field with a new line of smart home and home security products in collaboration with LG and Schneider Electric. Amazon updated its smart home line, including new AI-powered home cameras . And who knows what the future might bring? Some startups are offering AI dog robots as roving security guards . Bluesky blocks links to leaked DHS employee data as government seeks takedowns
items.d: The social networking site is facing criticism for blocking access to the site, which identifies thousands of ICE agents and other employees working for Homeland Security.
items.fullText: Following a sizable leak of personnel data about employees who work for the U.S. Department of Homeland Security, social network Bluesky is now blocking its users from accessing a nonprofit’s website that hosts the leaked dataset. Users reported that the links to nonprofit transparency collective DDoSecrets were marked as “malicious” soon after TechCrunch and other media outlets broke the news that Homeland Security had been hacked. A screenshot showing Bluesky blocking links to DDoSecrets Image Credits: TechCrunch TechCrunch reported on Wednesday that a hacker obtained over 40,000 user account records from Homeland Security’s login system, including the names and contact information, such as work-issued phone numbers and email addresses, of employees and agents working for its various agencies like Customs and Border Protection (CBP) and Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE). The data included information that was similar to that on an employee’s business card. DDoSecrets, which publishes leaked datasets in the public interest, also made the hacked data publicly available. Researchers who are investigating abuses by the Trump administration say that the data will be invaluable for seeking records from the government under public records laws. A spokesperson for Homeland Security told TechCrunch on Wednesday that it was “aware of a potential breach and is actively working to address the situation swiftly and effectively.” In a statement, Bluesky chief operating officer Rose Wang told TechCrunch: “Our Community Guidelines protect people’s safety and privacy by prohibiting the unauthorized sharing of personal information and other content that could pose safety risks. items.fullText: Pioneers Across Europe Deploy NVIDIA Earth-2 Open Models to Power Real-World Weather and Climate Prediction October 21, 2026 by Niall Robinson 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Weather forecasts shape more than daily plans; timely weather information is crucial for energy producers, insurers and transport operators to plan around changing conditions. A global forecast can show a storm taking shape, but decisions about solar farms, shipping routes or insured property depend on what happens locally. NVIDIA Earth-2 gives developers and researchers a family of open AI models and tools they can customize with their own data. Running on NVIDIA computing, these technologies support global weather prediction, detailed regional forecasts and environmental research. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements StormScope EU is the latest model to join Earth-2 — a regional version of the StormScope model for short-term forecasting, trained over Europe weather and climate data. It uses EUMETSAT satellite observations to predict evolving cloud conditions across 16 Meteosat channels at 10-minute intervals. At GTC Berlin, NVIDIA is showcasing a live StormScope EU pipeline in an interactive weather demo built in partnership with Earthmover . The demo uses Earth2Studio to run forecasts and Earthmover’s data platform to manage and serve the real-time results, which are updated as soon as new satellite observations come in, every 10 minutes. Earthmover serves these results as map tiles, letting visitors explore predictions across Europe without downloading entire datasets. Developers can combine Earth-2 models in workflows tailored to regional needs, using StormScope for short-term forecasting and CorrDiff to add local detail to coarser weather data.
